title: Children's Residential Support Worker
summary: Day shifts, waking nights and sleep-ins across children's homes. Trauma-informed, relationship-based care.
body:
## The position

The homes support children and young people with a range of emotional and behavioural needs, using trauma-informed, child-centred and relationship-based approaches. You'll play a vital role in providing consistent, high-quality care that helps young people feel safe, supported and empowered.

The position is initially temporary, with the opportunity to become permanent for the right candidates.

## What's on offer

- Excellent rates of pay.
- Flexible working.
- Day shifts, waking nights and sleep-in shifts available.
- Work across residential homes in north Essex.
- Ongoing support throughout your placement.

## The role

- Provide consistent, high-quality care and support to children and young people.
- Help maintain a safe, nurturing and well-organised home.
- Build positive relationships while keeping appropriate professional boundaries.
- Support young people to develop independence and life skills, including cooking, travel and self-care.
- Follow care plans, behaviour support strategies and risk assessments.
- Complete accurate daily records and handovers.
- Administer medication and carry out safety checks where trained and authorised.
- Transport young people to school, appointments and activities when required.
- Work with colleagues and follow safeguarding procedures at all times.

## About you

- Naturally caring, patient and empathetic.
- Calm and resilient under pressure, able to set clear and consistent boundaries.
- A reliable team player who works professionally in residential settings.
